snippet.title: [Mongil:STAR DIVE] Developer Greeting | Closed Beta Recruitment!
snippet.description:
Mongil: STAR DIVE Director Appearance! 😎
The Director personally introduces the game and shares the Closed Beta Test schedule!

▶ Apply for the Closed Beta
https://ntiny.link/stardive_yt

「Become our very first tester—join as a Mongiller.」

✨ Special events are prepared for the 🔥1st Mongillers🔥participating in the Closed Beta!
Sign up now and don’t miss out on the rewards!

#MongilSTARDIVE #Mongil #STARDRIVE #MonsterTaming #Netmarble
